gold.user: As a project manager, I want to retrieve all available fields in Jira to understand what data I can use for my project.
gold.ideal: Returns a list of all fields with their details, including custom fields and system fields.

gold.user: As a product owner, I want to create a custom field for tracking user feedback so that we can better manage feature requests.
gold.ideal: Creates a new custom field and returns the details of the created field, including its ID and configuration.

gold.user: As a developer, I want to fetch fields in a paginated manner to efficiently handle large datasets in my application.
gold.ideal: Returns a paginated list of fields with metadata, allowing for easy navigation through the results.

gold.user: As an admin, I want to view trashed fields to decide if any should be restored or permanently deleted.
gold.ideal: Returns a paginated list of trashed fields, including their details and the option to restore them.

gold.user: As a project administrator, I want to update the configuration of an existing custom field to better suit our project needs.
gold.ideal: Updates the specified custom field and returns the updated field details.

gold.user: As a project manager, I want to delete a custom field that is no longer needed to keep our project clean.
